verdict.rationale: cubic documents kicking off agent work from GitHub PR comments: @cubic-dev-ai triggers reviews, and 'Fix with cubic' generates fixes and pushes them to the PR branch. The evidence only covers GitHub; Linear appears only as linked-issue requirement analysis, not as a way to start tasks. missing for 10: GitLab triggering, Linear-initiated agent tasks, Slack triggering, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can kick off agent tasks directly from GitHub, GitLab, Linear, or Slack

citations.quote: Interact with cubic in PR comments to ask questions, trigger reviews, and fix issues.
Post this comment on GitHub to start a review
cubic generates the fix and pushes it to your PR branch.
